encounters.evidence: When I started having GI issues, doctors thought it was related to my arthritis meds. Spent two years trying different NSAIDs.
Finally, colonoscopy revealed extensive Crohn's. Doc said we could treat both conditions with same biologic. Started on Stelara.

extraction_notes: Patient had two prior biologic failures for psoriasis before Crohn's diagnosis; these are listed in treatments as they are relevant to the treatment history but predate the Crohn's diagnosis. NSAIDs are included because they were used during the diagnostic workup period and likely worsened GI disease. Methotrexate is listed as not_started — decision pending next month. Depression mentioned but antidepressants excluded from treatments per schema rules (unrelated comorbidity). The two unnamed prior biologics for psoriasis are grouped as one treatment entry since no names are given. Biologic status is 'on' (Stelara currently) even though a switch or add-on is being actively discussed.
